description:
Validate vault files against the schemas; the exit code says whether the vault is clean.

Usage: lint [--quiet] [--schemas DIR] [PATH ...]

Args:
  PATH  zero or more files to validate; default: walk the whole vault

Flags:
  --quiet  no per-violation output; exit code only
  --schemas DIR  schemas directory; default the bundled schemas; omit it

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]

Notes:
  Violations print as <path>:<line>: <message>, with absolute paths. Non-UTF-8 files appear as 'file is not valid UTF-8'.
  Pass PATHs as the absolute paths other commands print; relative paths resolve against the working directory, not the vault.
  Run after hand-editing vault files and before commit save.
  Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: violations found. Exit 2: no schemas loaded.
